$comment: Homepage freshness configuration: controls hero presentation, top/bottom/explore/guidance carousels, slot pinning, and date overrides.

hero.$comment: Hero banner slides configuration: auto-pools from library/hero/*.md, supporting slot pinning and date overrides.

pinned.$comment: Pin the sacred alankara slide at first position (slot 0)

top_carousel.$comment: Top rail carousel: auto-pools from library/pages/*.md with slot pinning and holiday overrides.

overrides.$comment: Special event override for Karthika Deepotsava / festival window

bottom_carousel.$comment: Bottom rail carousel: auto-pools remaining pages from library/pages/*.md (excluding top_carousel pages to prevent duplicates).

explore_carousel.$comment: Explore carousel: dynamically rotates across all library collections including Bhakti/Dasasahitya, Dharma, Shastra, and Stories.

guidance_carousel.$comment: Guidance carousel: dynamically rotates through all Sevas and Spiritual Remedies.
